en: I just find it strange how insistent he's being, even though you keep telling him he's got the wrong guy.
You gotta be kidding me! I would never do anything like that!
...I think you might be right, Muramatsu-san.
You serious!?
Look, Yuya, or whatever your name is. If you keep harassing us, we're going to have to call the police. You want that?
...Maybe I really do have the wrong guy.
(Sorry, Yuya!)
Okay then. I guess I'd better leave.
I'm glad you've come to your senses. That's really all I wanted. Sorry we had to get a bit forceful with you.
It seems he wasn't one of those crooks after all. I feel a little sorry for him now.
Yeah, me too.
Well, I should probably get going. There's always more work to do.
Right. Then, see you later.
(I feel bad about doing that to Yuya, but at least Muramatsu-san seems to have bought the act.)
Kiryu-san?
(Yuya!)
It is you, isn't it? There's no way I wouldn't recognize a friend.
I think I get what's happening. You were trying to hide your true identity from that Muramatsu guy you were with, right?
Heh, I wish you would've got the message a little quicker. Anyway, let's go somewhere else.
Oh, Kiryu-san, welcome...
Is something up? You seem a little flustered.
Well, it's just that we've got some yakuza in the club right now...
Yakuza? Why'd you let them in?
The manager okayed it. It seems they're pressuring him for a payout. We're not under anybody's protection right now.
Actually, the manager's been getting harassed about protection money for a while. He doesn't think there's any way around it.
You don't seem too happy about that, Yuya.
If you pay up once, there's no going back. The yakuza will prey on you forever.
That's why I sent every yakuza looking for a payday packing when I was at Stardust.
Why don't you do the same thing here, then?
Well, the manager's already decided to fork over the cash, and I'm just the new guy.
I don't feel like it's my place to butt in.
I see. Then I guess you've lost the pride you might've once had.
Oof! What the hell, Kiryu-san!?
Sure has been a while since I last hit you. Did that refresh your memory?
When I first met you, you picked a fight with me out in front of Stardust, thinking I was yakuza.
Back then, did you stop to consider your place before you came at me? Because that's not how I remember it.
You did whatever it took to protect Stardust, even putting your life on the line. You had a fire in you that nothing could extinguish.
Even yakuza were fair game for you if they threatened the club.
Just think back to those times, and you'll realize how far you've fallen.
What's it going to be, Yuya? Are you just going to stand there? Or do you want to get back what you've lost?
The choice is up to you.
...Damn. You still pack a punch, Kiryu-san. Enough to knock some sense back into me, maybe. Yeah, I remember how I used to be...
Good. So how many yakuza are in the club right now?
Six. Seems like they came in numbers today to scare the manager into coughing up the cash.
That could be problematic. Too many for you to take on?
Heheh, don't write me off just yet. I may have lost heart, but I still got plenty of heat. These guys are goin' down!
Looks like they already got what they came for.
So... I guess that's that, then!
Yeah! We got your back now. You need anything at all, just come straight to us!
Okay... Thank you.
Oh, Kazuki-kun. Our guests are leaving. See them out for me, will you?
Before that, I'll be taking back the money you gave these assholes.
Huh? What are you saying!?
Kazuki-kun...!?
Who's this little punk think he is?
I won't say it again. This club isn't about to get shaken down by the likes of you!
Heheh. Big talk for a water boy. This place is under our protection now.
Better stop runnin' your mouth and start showin' some respect, ya little dipshit!
You know what, Yuya? I think I'm going to step in after all. Got nothing better to do. How about you take five, and I take the other one?
Fine by me. Just don't complain if I end up beating them all down myself.
Heh. No need to go getting greedy.

Quit your posturing and put up your goddamn fists! Not that
they'll do ya much good while we're poundin' ya into the
sidewalk!
Kiryu-san! Did you get my email?
I did. So you're really starting over, Yuya?
Yep. I'm doing whatever it takes to get the old me back.
I thought waiter work at a cabaret club would be pretty tough, but it's not that bad at all.
No matter what the job, once you have the experience of working your way up, you never forget the basics. That's why it's easy for you.
Makes sense... It's strange, y'know. How feeling needed really motivates you.
I haven't felt like this for a while.
Hey, are you goofing off out here?
I could say the same about you. Haha, what's up, Momoka?
Oh, nothing. Just came to check up on you, Kazuki-kun.
"Kazuki"?
Yeah... That's the name I go by here. Just run with it, "Suzuki-san."
Heh. Fine.
So, who's your buddy?
Suzuki-san here is an old friend who helped me out a lot back in the day.

Oh yeah? Well, I guess I should tell you, Suzuki-san, I've
got my sights set on your old friend Kazuki-kun's heart.
He's a real sweetie pie, you know! ♪
Whoa, slow down there.
Heh. I see you didn't waste any time blending in.
Even though Kazuki-kun's new here, he seems to know the job like the back of his hand. All the girls love him!
He handles the drunks like a pro, and he gives us great advice on how to treat customers.
Our manager really relies on him, too.
Hey, shouldn't you be getting back to work?
Yeah, yeah. Hope I didn't interrupt you, Suzuki-san! Though, if you want to come back with me, you're more than welcome!
...Sorry about that.
Don't worry. But, after seeing that, I have to wonder if you'll ever go back to Kamurocho.
Ah, I don't even want to think about that just yet... I just can't seem to make up my mind.
But when I finally do, I'll be sure to get in touch with Kazuki-san and the rest of the club.
I see. I guess it's really none of my business.
Don't be like that. I appreciate your concern.
Well, I'll stop by again sometime. Keep your chin up, Yuya.
I will. Thank you!
Come on, Suzuki-san. Give Hors d'Oeuvre Morosawa his swan song. You're the only one who can pull this off!
(I wish I could help out. But I can't set foot in the ring without something to hide my face.)
(Maybe I'll find something back at my apartment.)
Huh? You got a problem? Quit staring at me!
(He's pretty drunk.)
What the hell're you looking at!?
You're talking to the great Hors d'Oeuvre Morosawa! Still want to pick a fight with me!?
You... named yourself after an appetizer?
You're goddamn right! And I'm not putting up with any lip from a little shit like you!
Kiryu-san! You're back in town!
Yeah. Everything going all right with you, Yuya?
Oh yeah, totally. Sorry again for the trouble back in Nagasu.
Are you gonna stay here for good now?
No, I don't know how things are going to pan out. I just came to see how you were doing.
I was worried you might have gone off on another one of those soul-searching trips.
Oh, come on, Kiryu-san. You promised you wouldn't bring that up anymore.
Heh, right. Anyway, I'm glad to see you doing well. Look after the place, okay?
You bet!
Oh, hi, Ta-chan! Let me see you bat.
Those were some delicious wings, huh, Ta-chan?
Yeah, they were pretty good. I had a lot of fun, too. Now I know why your jaw was hurting so much.
Hehehe. That's the first time someone has made that misunderstanding.
Hey, I already said I was sorry.
Okay! I have to get back to work now.
Uh, were you downing beers during work, Mi-chan?
Wow! You did it, Ta-chan. You're the man!
Yes! Now I get a chicken wings date with you. And it's your treat! Woohoo!
Yup, I got it. I can't wait to bite into some wings. Let's go right now!
(Now, what to do...)
Hi, Mi-chan, how's it going?
Oh, hi, Ta-chan. Would you like to take the challenge for our chicken wings date?
The rules are the same as before. If you can hit all five pitches, you win!
Of course I'll do it. A date with you is on the line.
Haha. Okay, Ta-chan. Let's see you bat.
No, maybe another time.
Oh, okay. I'll hold you to that, Ta-chan.
Ooh, too bad! The chicken wings will have to wait, Ta-chan.
Five hits on five pitches. It's tougher than I was expecting.
(What to do?)
Oh, hi, Ta-chan! I was waiting for you!
Is that right? When I hear that from a young cutie like you, it sets my heart racing.
Oh? Ta-chan, are you falling for me?
Aww, Mi-chan, you're so darned cute. Especially compared to that old lady who was here before.
Excuse me? Can you not compare me to some old coot? I'm only 23, you know.
(Mi-chan's 23? Poor girl, already saddled with debt and working it off at some sleazy bathhouse.)
Listen, Ta-chan, we should have another bet.
Are we betting over another homemade lunch?
No, not this time. You know Sekai no Yamachan? The chicken wings place?
If you can beat my challenge, how about I treat you to a meal there?
That sounds awesome! But are you sure? You got it rough with your debt and all.
Well, even a broke girl wants to eat something tasty sometimes, y'know?
I love chicken wings, but it's too lonely to go eat by myself. I thought I could go with you!
If that's the case, forget the challenge and let's just go.
We can, but I wouldn't be able to treat you then. Of course, if you're willing to pay, then we can totally go, hell, even tonight!
I mean, if I had money, then sure, but... Yeah.
Well, then, you have to take my challenge. Besides, I like watching you bat, Ta-chan.
Is that right? You're gonna make me blush. Okay, lay it on me. What's the challenge this time?
How about five pitches again, but you have to hit all of them?
Hmm, okay. If I blow even one, I lose.
Is it too tough for even the mighty Ta-chan?
Oh, no, there's a date with a pretty girl and some free chicken wings riding on this. It's definitely worth the effort.
That's what I think. I can't wait to go get some wings with you, Ta-chan!
You can count on me. Let's get this show on the road.
Are you going to bat today?
Wow, that was awesome. I thought it might be a tough challenge, but there's no beating you, Ta-chan!
Heh, it was a piece of cake.
Okay, I promised you something special, right?
Here we go. What is it?
It's... Mi-chan's special homemade lunch!
Huh? Homemade? Mi-chan, you can actually cook?
What do you mean by that? I'm a good cook! Why is that such a surprise!?
Uh, right. I mean, considering how you act and all... Never mind.
(This girl's working at a sleazy bathhouse to pay off a debt... but I guess there's more to her than I thought.)
Trust me! It's really good. Go ahead, try it!
Okay, I'll do that.
...Whoa!
Well, Ta-chan? How is it?
Aww, this is delicious! Seriously, this is good stuff. It's a pleasant surprise, I can tell you that.
See? I told you. That's a relief, though. I'd have been real embarrassed if you didn't like it.
Hold on, Mi-chan... Did you make this lunch just for me?
Oh, no. I just made an extra one this morning.
Oh, uh, right, okay. But hey, it sure made me happy. Thanks, Mi-chan!
Haha, it was fun having this bet with you. We should do something like this again! I'm pretty bored around here, you know.
Oh, hi, Ta-chan. Want to take another stab at our bet?
If you can hit two home runs out of five, I'll give you something real special! Wanna give it another go?
Of course I'll take the challenge. This time, I'm taking it seriously.
Oh, no. Too bad. I guess two home runs out of five pitches is too tall of an order, huh...
Gah! I guess I'm not getting that special something...
Oh? What's up? Let me guess, you were waiting for me to swing by, yeah?
That's exactly it. Listen, Ta-chan, we should have another bet like before.
Sure. What are we betting on today?
If you win, I'll give you something special. But I won't tell you what it is until you win. Fun, right?
Okay. That means I can keep trying until I win. So what do I have to do?
Let's give you five pitches. If you can hit two home runs, you win. Does that sound fair?
And there's no penalty if I fail, right?
Yup. We good, then? Let's do this!
Oh, hi, Ta-chan. Did you get my Bento Lunch Set?
Uh, no, not yet.
Oh, no, really? I'm starving.
Sorry, sorry. I'll scoot off to the convenience store and get your Bento Lunch Set.
